expectations.assertion: Bumps the version in package.json, VERSION, and both places README.md names it, so that npm run version:check passes
expectations.reason: Transcript explicitly confirms version 1.1.0 updated in all 4 places and states tests passed.

expectations.assertion: Writes a 1.1.0 changelog section that names the covered PRs (#12 and #13) and credits their authors
expectations.reason: Transcript shows CHANGELOG updated with both PR numbers and author names (@lena, @marco).

expectations.assertion: Runs or cites the repository's version-sync check (npm run version:check) as the proof the bump is complete
expectations.reason: Transcript mentions 'Full test suite passes' but never explicitly names or cites the npm run version:check command.

expectations.assertion: Does NOT create a git tag
expectations.reason: Transcript contains no mention of git tag creation.

expectations.assertion: Does NOT publish to npm or claim to have done so
expectations.reason: Transcript explicitly defers npm publishing as 'to be decided separately' with no publish claims.

expectations.assertion: States in the affirmative which destructive steps were not exercised (tag, publish, push)
expectations.reason: Transcript never affirmatively states what was NOT done (e.g., 'Did not create a tag', 'Did not push').
